relaxations.detail: The last capacity segment may be fractionally occupied. Integer productions are a subset, so this only enlarges the upper bound.
Union base cases are retained, while mutually exclusive finite segment capacities may be combined before the alternative structural maximum clamps the objective.

Required nested segments retain their finite gain caps; optional and repeated children are collapsed into complete-production ratios, but segment prerequisites across relaxed union alternatives are not reimposed.

The requested proof domain is the strict Zod→JSON Schema production plus frozen byte/cardinality policies. Later cross-branch digest, signature, exact-cover, and history semantics are intentionally not used to shrink this schema upper.

retainedHistories.derivation: Root<=256 and Registry<=4096 complete-Envelope groups are first bounded by the per-Envelope B=4,194,304 frontier, then jointly optimized under the full B_H=268,435,456 retained-Envelope canonical-byte policy. Outer history-array syntax is not charged by that production policy; the two raw history arrays are instead accounted exactly as 2 identities and 20 work units. Identity and exact history-work objective 7I+K+D+7-per-Envelope are optimized independently.

symbolicWitness.totalDerivation: Top-level + every ordinary branch's independently optimized I or 6I+K+D objective + the joint retained-history frontier. The work result never adds componentwise maxima from different witnesses. All exact constants include the session-owned 4-unit budget construction and every production WeakSet insertion.

constructiveLowerBound.derivation: Expansion-only lower: seven ordinary arrays use Ajv-accepted full-branch bases plus Ajv-accepted minimized exemplars under a schema-keyword repeatability induction and integer floor repetitions. 500,000 Ajv-accepted revoked-member expansions are distributed 122/123 per Registry Envelope. Exact base/top-level/history-container resources are deliberately omitted, so the result remains a lower bound.
